title: Adjusting to Working from Home
paragraphs: Ketika perusahaannya mulai mengizinkan kerja jarak jauh dua kali seminggu, Ferdi awalnya kesulitan memisahkan jam kerja dari waktu pribadinya saat duduk di meja dapur yang sama sepanjang hari. Selama beberapa minggu pertama, ia mendapati dirinya memeriksa pesan hingga larut malam, tidak bisa secara mental menutup hari kerjanya seperti yang biasa ia lakukan secara alami saat meninggalkan gedung kantor.

Istrinya menyarankan untuk mengatur rutinitas yang jelas, termasuk berganti pakaian setiap pagi dan menutup laptopnya pada waktu tetap setiap malam, memperlakukannya seperti perjalanan kerja sungguhan meski tanpa perjalanan itu. Setelah menerapkan rutinitas kecil ini, Ferdi menyadari malam-malamnya terasa lebih tenang dan lebih hadir bersama keluarganya, menyadari bahwa struktur, bukan hanya lokasi, adalah yang sebenarnya membuat kerja terasa seperti kerja.
answerKey: When his company shifts to allowing remote work twice a week, Ferdi struggles at first to separate his work hours from his personal time while sitting at the same kitchen table all day. During the first few weeks, he finds himself checking messages late into the evening, unable to mentally close his workday the way he naturally could when he physically left an office building. His wife suggests setting a clear routine instead, including changing clothes each morning and closing his laptop at a fixed time every evening, treating it like a real commute even without one. After adopting this small routine, Ferdi notices his evenings feel calmer and more present with his family, realizing that structure, not just location, was what actually made work feel like work.
